pairs.target: mù shuān kǎ zài bànkāi de wèizhì , xiàng yíshàn bùkěn ràng rén jìn de xiǎomén .
pairs.english: The wooden latch was stuck half open, like a little door refusing entry.
pairs.hanzi: 木闩卡在半开的位置，像一扇不肯让人进的小门。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu shēnshǒu tuī .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't reach out to push.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有伸手推。

pairs.target: nà shì jīntiān yào zuò de liànxí , búshì zhuāng huài le de hézi .
pairs.english: This was today's exercise, not a badly assembled box.
pairs.hanzi: 那是今天要做的练习，不是装坏了的盒子。

pairs.target: hégài biān de mù shuān yóu yìgēn xiǎo tiě huáng yāzhù , shuān kǒng lǐ héngchuān zhe xiāodīng .
pairs.english: A small iron spring pressed the latch beside the lid; a pin ran through the latch hole.
pairs.hanzi: 盒盖边的木闩由一根小铁簧压住，闩孔里横穿着销钉。

pairs.target: píngcháng xiāodīng shòuyā , chōu bù chūlái ;
pairs.english: Normally the pin was under pressure and couldn't be pulled out;
pairs.hanzi: 平常销钉受压，抽不出来；

pairs.target: ràng tiě huáng zài tóngyàng qīngzǎi xià duō ràng yìdiǎn , shuān biàn néng yíkāi shǎoxǔ , gěi xiāodīng liúchū kòngxì .
pairs.english: if the spring yielded a little more under the same light load, the latch could move slightly, leaving clearance for the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 让铁簧在同样轻载下多让一点，闩便能移开少许，给销钉留出空隙。

pairs.target: lìng yípiàn tiě yàng gùdìng zài pángbiān de jiàshàng , xuán zhe xiǎo fǎmǎ .
pairs.english: The other iron sample was fixed on an adjacent rig, with a small weight suspended.
pairs.hanzi: 另一片铁样固定在旁边的架上，悬着小砝码。

pairs.target: tā chéngdān xiāngfǎn de biànhuà , xiàmiàn yǒu yídào dǎng kuài , liǎngbiān dōu búhuì luòdào rén de shǒushàng .
pairs.english: It took the opposite change, with a stop below; neither side could fall onto anyone's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 它承担相反的变化，下面有一道挡块，两边都不会落到人的手上。

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn tiě de tǐjī , jiēchùmiàn de xì cáo hé guāngluǒ chù , wéi lǎoshī gāng zhúxiàng yàn guò .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey had just checked both iron pieces' volumes, the fine contact grooves, and the bare patches, item by item.
pairs.hanzi: 两片铁的体积、接触面的细槽和光裸处，维老师刚逐项验过。

pairs.target: háishì tā liàn shú de nà zǔ xiǎoyàng , méiyǒu huànchéng dà jīguān .
pairs.english: These were still his familiar small samples, not a new, large mechanism.
pairs.hanzi: 还是他练熟的那组小样，没有换成大机关。

pairs.target: luò héng bǎ bǎichuí bōkāi .
pairs.english: Lohen set the pendulum moving.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把摆锤拨开。

pairs.target: mù shé pèng zhe jià biān , fāchū jūnyún de qīng xiǎng .
pairs.english: Its wooden tongue struck the frame, giving a steady soft sound.
pairs.hanzi: 木舌碰着架边，发出均匀的轻响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi búbì děng dìèrshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't have to wait for the second click.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不必等第二声。

pairs.target: néng zài dìyīshēng zhīhòu chōuchū xiāodīng , zài tóngshí jiē huí liǎngchù luǒ miàn , zhǔdòng jiéshù , jiùsuàn zuò wán .
pairs.english: If he pulled the pin after the first, then touched both bare patches together and deliberately ended the exchange, the task was complete.
pairs.hanzi: 能在第一声之后抽出销钉，再同时接回两处裸面，主动结束，就算做完。

pairs.target: ruò gòu búdào , huòzhě xiāodīng bùkěn zǒu , jiù xiān jiéshù , bùnéng kào duō chēng yíhuìer jiějué .
pairs.english: If he couldn't reach, or the pin wouldn't move, he must end it first, not try to solve it by holding longer.
pairs.hanzi: 若够不到，或者销钉不肯走，就先结束，不能靠多撑一会儿解决。

pairs.target: zhè tàohuà tā yǐjīng néng zìjǐ shuō chūlái .
pairs.english: He could already recite all that himself.
pairs.hanzi: 这套话他已经能自己说出来。

pairs.target: zhēn zuò dào jià qián , tā què fāxiàn nà méi xiāodīng bǐ zhǐ shàng de jiàntóu duǎn dé duō .
pairs.english: But seated at the rig, he found the pin far shorter than the arrow in the drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 真坐到架前，他却发现那枚销钉比纸上的箭头短得多。

pairs.target: " nǐ bǎ tā huà dé tài cháng le . " tā duì luò héng shuō . " wǒ bǎshǒu yě huà xiǎo le . "
pairs.english: “You drew it too long,” he told Lohen. “I drew the hand too small too.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你把它画得太长了。”他对洛衡说。
“我把手也画小了。”

pairs.target: nà zhāng cǎotú shàng de shǒu zhǐyǒu sāngè zhǐtou .
pairs.english: The hand in the sketch had only three fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 那张草图上的手只有三个指头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , bǎ xiùkǒu wǎng shàng fān , xiān bú zuò jiè xìng ,
pairs.english: Tavi laughed, rolled up his cuffs, and rehearsed without an exchange:
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，把袖口往上翻，先不做借性，

pairs.target: kōngshǒu zǒu le yíbiàn qǔ xiāo , fàng xiāo , jiē huí liǎngpiàn tiě de dòngzuò .
pairs.english: empty-handed, he went through taking the pin, setting it down, and touching both irons again.
pairs.hanzi: 空手走了一遍取销、放销、接回两片铁的动作。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ dìyībiàn kāishǐ dé hěn wěn .
pairs.english: The morning's first attempt began steadily.
pairs.hanzi: 上午第一遍开始得很稳。

pairs.target: zhǎng xià liǎngbiān de xiǎngyìng yì sōng yì jǐn ,
pairs.english: Beneath his palms, one response loosened and the other stiffened.
pairs.hanzi: 掌下两边的响应一松一紧，

alignment.english: one response loosened and the other

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhuī zhe mù shuān zǒu , érshì děng bǎichuí yòu guò yícì , cái tóngshí tíqǐ shǒu .
pairs.english: Instead of following the latch, he waited one more pendulum swing before lifting both hands together.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有追着木闩走，而是等摆锤又过一次，才同时提起手。

pairs.target: mù shuān guǒrán liúxià le kòngxì .
pairs.english: The latch did leave a gap.
pairs.hanzi: 木闩果然留下了空隙。

pairs.target: tā niēzhù xiāo tóu , wǎng wài chōu , xiāodīng què wāi zhe cā zhù le mù kǒng .
pairs.english: He grasped the pin head and pulled, but the pin tilted and scraped against the wooden hole.
pairs.hanzi: 他捏住销头，往外抽，销钉却歪着擦住了木孔。

pairs.target: zài yòng diǎn lì jiù xíng .
pairs.english: A little more force would do it.
pairs.hanzi: 再用点力就行。

pairs.target: tā de yòushǒu yǐjīng gēnzhe zhège niàntou bēngjǐn , zuǒshǒu què xiānhuídào le tiěpiàn shàng ,
pairs.english: His right hand had already tightened at the thought, but his left returned to the iron first,
pairs.hanzi: 他的右手已经跟着这个念头绷紧，左手却先回到了铁片上，

pairs.target: suíhòu yòushǒu yě fàngkāi xiāodīng , jiē huí lìng yípiàn .
pairs.english: then his right released the pin and touched the other strip again.
pairs.hanzi: 随后右手也放开销钉，接回另一片。

pairs.target: tā jiěkāi jiè xìng , mù shuān huīfù shòuyā de wèizhì , méi chōu wán de xiāodīng liúzài kǒng lǐ .
pairs.english: He unwound the exchange; the latch returned to its loaded position, leaving the partly withdrawn pin in the hole.
pairs.hanzi: 他解开借性，木闩恢复受压的位置，没抽完的销钉留在孔里。

pairs.target: bǎichuí hái zài xiǎng . luò héng méiyǒu tì tā bǎ xiāo qǔchū lái .
pairs.english: The pendulum kept clicking. Lohen didn't remove the pin for him.
pairs.hanzi: 摆锤还在响。洛衡没有替他把销取出来。

pairs.target: " gāngcái wèishénme tíng ? " wéi lǎoshī wèn .
pairs.english: “Why did you stop?” Instructor Vey asked.
pairs.hanzi: “刚才为什么停？”维老师问。

pairs.target: " wǒ dé nǐng zhe chōu . " tǎ wéi kànzhe zìjǐ de yòushǒu , " láibùjí . "
pairs.english: “I'd have had to twist it out.” Tavi looked at his right hand. “Not enough time.”
pairs.hanzi: “我得拧着抽。”塔维看着自己的右手，“来不及。”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ dìyīcì jì zuò zhōngzhǐ , jiào tā xiān líkāi jiàzi .
pairs.english: She nodded, recorded the first attempt as aborted, and told him to step away from the rig.
pairs.hanzi: 她点头，把第一次记作中止，叫他先离开架子。

pairs.target: búshì zàishìyícì jiù yídìng néng yíng de nàzhǒng shíhòu .
pairs.english: This wasn't the sort of moment when just trying again guaranteed a win.
pairs.hanzi: 不是再试一次就一定能赢的那种时候。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù yuànlǐ hēshuǐ , huílái shí dé mǎ zhèngzài línzhuō zuò tā de liànxí .
pairs.english: Tavi went to drink water in the yard; when he returned, Dema was doing her exercise at the next table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去院里喝水，回来时德玛正在邻桌做她的练习。

pairs.target: tā de xiāodīng cháoxiàng bùtóng , shēnshǒu yě jìn xiē .
pairs.english: Her pin faced differently and was closer to reach.
pairs.hanzi: 她的销钉朝向不同，伸手也近些。

pairs.target: tā xiān tiáo yǐzi , yòu qǐng luò héng tì tā kàn cèmiàn ,
pairs.english: She adjusted her chair first, then asked Lohen to watch from the side;
pairs.hanzi: 她先调椅子，又请洛衡替她看侧面，

pairs.target: zuò wán hòu méiyǒu jí zhe kàn wéi lǎoshī , érshì zìjǐ bǎ liǎngbiān de dúshù hé huí yuánwèi .
pairs.english: after finishing, rather than looking straight to Vey, she checked both readings had returned herself.
pairs.hanzi: 做完后没有急着看维老师，而是自己把两边的读数核回原位。

pairs.target: " nǐ liàn guò zhège ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Have you practised this?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “你练过这个？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " kōng jià liàn le hǎo jǐtiān . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “On the empty rig for several days,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “空架练了好几天。”她说，

pairs.target: " nǐmen chūfā nàtiān , wǒ děng xiàwǔ nà zǔ , zǎoshàng méi kè . "
pairs.english: “The day you left, I was waiting for the afternoon group. No morning class.”
pairs.hanzi: “你们出发那天，我等下午那组，早上没课。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěn píngcháng .
pairs.english: She said it quite casually.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很平常。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi què xiǎngqǐ hòuchē pénglǐ de fēng ,
pairs.english: But Tavi remembered the wind in the waiting shelter,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维却想起候车棚里的风，

pairs.target: hūrán míngbái zìjǐ jìzhù de shì wàimiàn , tā nàtiān yě yǒu tā zìjǐ de shàngwǔ .
pairs.english: and suddenly realized he remembered being outside, while she had had a morning of her own that day.
pairs.hanzi: 忽然明白自己记住的是外面，她那天也有她自己的上午。

pairs.target: tā bǎ nà zhāng sān zhǐtou de cǎotú fānguòlái , chóngxīn huà xiāo tóu de wèizhì .
pairs.english: He turned over the three-fingered sketch and redrew the pin head's position.
pairs.hanzi: 他把那张三指头的草图翻过来，重新画销头的位置。

pairs.target: búshì jiācháng xiāodīng , érshì ràng zìjǐ zuò dé zhèng yìxiē , búbì xié zhe chōu .
pairs.english: He wouldn't lengthen the pin; instead he would sit straighter, without having to pull diagonally.
pairs.hanzi: 不是加长销钉，而是让自己坐得正一些，不必斜着抽。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī chóngxīn jiǎnchá hòu , cái xǔ tā zuò dìèrbiàn .
pairs.english: Only after checking again did Instructor Vey allow a second attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师重新检查后，才许他做第二遍。

pairs.target: zhèhuí dìyīshēng qīng xiǎng luòxià , xiāodīng biàn dào le tā de zhǎngxīn .
pairs.english: This time, as the first soft click fell, the pin reached his palm.
pairs.hanzi: 这回第一声轻响落下，销钉便到了他的掌心。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā fàngjìn qiǎndié , shuāngshǒu jiē huí tiěpiàn , jiéshù jiè xìng .
pairs.english: He put it in the shallow dish, touched the irons with both hands, and ended the exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 他把它放进浅碟，双手接回铁片，结束借性。

pairs.target: luò héng dītóu héduì , liǎnggè zhǐzhēn dōu huídào gèzì yuánlái de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Lohen looked down to check: both pointers had returned to their own original positions.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡低头核对，两个指针都回到各自原来的地方。

pairs.target: mù shuān bèi dǎng kuài jiē zhù , méiyǒu zá xiàlái .
pairs.english: The stop caught the latch, keeping it from crashing down.
pairs.hanzi: 木闩被挡块接住，没有砸下来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe dié lǐ de xiāodīng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the pin in the dish.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着碟里的销钉。

pairs.target: tā búguò shì yìxiǎo jié móliàng de jīnshǔ , biānshàng yǒu yígè pǔtōng de yuántóu ,
pairs.english: It was only a short piece of polished metal with an ordinary round head,
pairs.hanzi: 它不过是一小截磨亮的金属，边上有一个普通的圆头，

pairs.target: kě tā gāngcái quèshí téngchū le shuāngshǒu , zuò wán le yíjiàn shì , ránhòu bǎ biànhuà shōu le huílái .
pairs.english: but he really had freed both hands, completed something, and brought the change back to an end.
pairs.hanzi: 可他刚才确实腾出了双手，做完了一件事，然后把变化收了回来。

pairs.target: " hái zuò ma ? " luò héng wèn .
pairs.english: “Again?” Lohen asked.
pairs.hanzi: “还做吗？”洛衡问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huódòng le yíxià shǒuzhǐ . méiyǒu má , yǎnjīng què yǐjīng bú yuàn zài dīngzhù nà liǎngdào xì kèxiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi flexed his fingers. No numbness, but his eyes no longer wanted to focus on those two fine marks.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维活动了一下手指。没有麻，眼睛却已经不愿再盯住那两道细刻线。

pairs.target: " bú zuò le . lún nǐ . "
pairs.english: “No. Your turn.”
pairs.hanzi: “不做了。轮你。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ yǐzi ràngkāi , zuò dào jìlù de yícè .
pairs.english: He gave up the chair and sat at the recording side.
pairs.hanzi: 他把椅子让开，坐到记录的一侧。

pairs.target: luò héng de shǒu bǐ tā dà , dìyījiàn shì jiùshì bǎ yǐzi wǎnghòu nuó .
pairs.english: Lohen's hands were larger than his; the first thing he did was move the chair back.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡的手比他大，第一件事就是把椅子往后挪。

pairs.target: xiàkèhòu , dé mǎ wèn néng bunéng jiè zǒu nà zhāng cǎotú .
pairs.english: After class, Dema asked to borrow the sketch.
pairs.hanzi: 下课后，德玛问能不能借走那张草图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xīn huà de nà miàncháo shàng dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi handed it to her with the new drawing upwards.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把新画的那面朝上递给她。

pairs.target: tā piānyào fānguòqù kàn nà zhī sāngēn zhǐtou de shǒu ,
pairs.english: She insisted on turning it over to see the three-fingered hand,
pairs.hanzi: 她偏要翻过去看那只三根指头的手，

pairs.target: xiào zhe shuō , zhìshǎo zhèhuí méi bǎ mǔzhǐ huà zài wàibiān .
pairs.english: laughing that at least this time he hadn't drawn the thumb on the outside.
pairs.hanzi: 笑着说，至少这回没把拇指画在外边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēn tā zhēng le bàntiáo zǒuláng , cái fāxiàn tā shǒulǐ ná zhe de zhǐ yìzhí shì dǎo de .
pairs.english: Tavi argued for half a corridor before noticing she'd been holding the paper upside down all along.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟她争了半条走廊，才发现她手里拿着的纸一直是倒的。
